headline: A 2018 law renamed a Jacksonville, Florida post office building after Rutledge Pearson.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1100 Kings Road in Jacksonville, Florida, the "Rutledge Pearson Post Office Building." It only changes the official name of the building. It does not change mail service, staffing, or postal rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 23, 2018, and the name took effect on that date.
